body.statement: Does every failure of uniform identification over \(\mathfrak M(H,d)\) admit a collision certificate in which every latent root has at most \(B(H,d)=2^n\prod_{v\in V}d(v)+4n^2+1\) states, while preserving the complete common observed law, all macro intervention distributions, strict observed positivity, prescribed alphabets, and both exact active micrographs? The Handle is the paired response-table compression that retains the joint observational, interventional, activity, and normalization coordinates before support reduction.
body.justification: A general formula-or-collision theorem needs a finite inspectable witness theorem beyond the single explicit cyclic example.
body.gap: ShpitserPearl2006JointID constructs a hedge pair for one fixed ADMG, and ZhangTianBareinboim2022PartialCF canonicalizes one fixed graph; neither jointly enforces a same-positive-law collision across two exact refinements with active advertised edges.
body.consumer: A positive solution supplies the bounded negative-output subroutine required by the conditional Global-CID theorem.
